evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

observations.why: Quinton establishes a mandatory procedural requirement (legitimate authority) backed by specific empirical justification from last quarter's incidents (rational persuasion).
Formally records the policy mandate establishing release requirements.
Defines the jurisdictional reach of the mandated governance process.
Designates formal ownership and institutional authority for the gate.
